deductions.reason: Nobody on the team has shipped production code with it

risks: Compiler-plugin coupling: each Kotlin upgrade waits for a compatible serialization-extras release.
The JSON-to-Protobuf bridge is the newest part of the library and the least battle-tested.
recommendation: Adopt for the shared KMP networking module. It removes ~600 lines of custom serializers, adds two dependencies we already ship, and has a strong maintenance and security record. The only gap is first-hand experience; have Riley migrate one endpoint first and keep the old serializers until it has run a release cycle.
